description: This Scala source file defines the MLHandler object and related helper classes for managing machine learning operations within Spark Connect, including command handling, object attribute access, and relation transformations.

classes.name: Method
classes.description: Represents a method with its name, argument values, and argument classes.

classes.name: AttributeHelper
classes.description: Helper class for retrieving object attributes via reflection, supporting method invocation with optional arguments.

classes.name: ModelAttributeHelper
classes.description: Specialized AttributeHelper for models, supporting transformation operations.

methods.name: parseMethods
methods.description: Parses method protobufs into Method objects with argument values and classes.

methods.name: apply (AttributeHelper)
methods.description: Creates an AttributeHelper instance from session, object ID, and method protobufs.

methods.name: apply (ModelAttributeHelper)
methods.description: Creates a ModelAttributeHelper instance from session, object ID, and method protobufs.

methods.name: _handleMlCommand
methods.description: Internal method to handle various ML commands such as fit, fetch, delete, read, evaluate, create summary, and get model size.

methods.name: wrapHandler
methods.description: Wraps command execution with thread-local timing and interruption handling, providing error reporting.

methods.name: handleMlCommand
methods.description: Public method to handle ML commands with thread interruption safety.

methods.name: createModelSummary
methods.description: Creates a training summary for a model if not already present.

methods.name: _transformMLRelation
methods.description: Transforms an ML relation protobuf into a DataFrame, handling different relation types.

methods.name: transformMLRelation
methods.description: Public method to transform an ML relation protobuf into a DataFrame with thread safety.
